content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 112 training seats are available under the SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Vacancy 2026 notification, distributed across three programmes as shown below.

content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from eligible underprivileged candidates who are residents of Sundargarh District and other Districts of Odisha State. Preference is given to candidates from the direct impact zones of RSP, namely Bisra Block, Kuarmunda Block, Nuagaon Block, and Lathikata Block of Sundargarh District, Rourkela Municipality, Rourkela Industrial Township area, Resettlement Colonies of RSP, and model steel villages of RSP in Odisha. Candidates who have previously undergone a similar training programme at IGH are not eligible for a second tenure. The qualification required depends on the specific training programme a candidate wishes to apply for. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

rows.required_qualification: Passed MBA/BBA/PG Diploma in Hospital Management, Hospital Administration, HR, Marketing, or Finance (minimum 2-year duration for MBA, 3-year duration for BBA, 2-year duration for PG Diploma) from any recognized institute. Preference is given to candidates holding an MBA/BBA/PG Diploma specifically in Hospital Management/Hospital Administration.
Passed Intermediate (10+2) Examination from a recognized Council, and completed 1 year of Hospital Attendant/Anesthesia Attendant Training programme from a reputed institute/hospital

content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention any application fee for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026. Candidates should rely on the official application portal at the time of applying for the latest fee-related information, if any.

content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Since this is a training programme and not a regular job, selected candidates receive a monthly stipend during the one-year training period rather than a salary. The stipend amount varies by training programme, as detailed below. The training period is one year, subject to the candidate clearing medical fitness as per Company rules. The notification explicitly states that this programme is meant only for skill enhancement of underprivileged candidates and is not for claiming future employment in SAIL, RSP.

content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026 programme is through an interview. The notification does not mention any written examination. Broadly, the process includes: Screening of online applications against the eligibility criteria for the chosen training programme Interview of eligible/shortlisted candidates, with venue, date and time intimated via SMS to the registered mobile number, and also published on the official website and the IGH notice board Document verification at the time of the interview, using original and self-attested photocopies of required certificates Medical fitness check as per Company rules, since selection is subject to medical fitness SAIL/RSP reserves the right to reject any application, or cancel the candidature or the entire training process, without assigning any reason, and no enquiry or correspondence will be entertained regarding this.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria must apply "ONLINE" only through https://igh.sailrsp.co.in . No other means or mode of application will be accepted. The step-by-step process is as follows: Visit the official website: https://igh.sailrsp.co.in Click on "Apply for Trainee Advt. No.-Ref. No. HR-T&M/2498, Date: 31/08/2026" listed under the "What's New" section On the next page, select the "Online Application Form" option (as opposed to "View Filled Form") Fill in all required fields in the application form and click "Submit". An Application ID will be generated on successful submission - candidates must note this ID for future reference, as no changes can be made after submission After submitting, view the filled data and click "PRINT" to take a printout of the Filled Application Form (Page 1), Declaration Form (Page 2), and Document Verification Form (Page 3) Sign on the printed forms wherever required and paste one recent passport-size colour photograph at the appropriate place on the application form If a candidate submitted the form but forgot to print it, they can revisit the site, click "View Filled Form", enter their Application ID, and print it from there Incomplete applications, or applications not fulfilling the eligibility criteria, will be summarily rejected, and no communication will be entertained from the applicant regarding rejection.

content_sections.heading: SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following points in mind before and after applying: This training programme does not entitle candidates to future employment in SAIL or RSP Candidates who have previously undergone a similar training programme at IGH are not eligible for a second tenure No accommodation will be provided to trainees during the training period; candidates must make their own arrangements Eligible candidates must attend the interview with the downloaded/printed application form, filled Declaration Form, and Document Verification Form, along with original and self-attested photocopies of required documents; failure to do so will lead to summary rejection of candidature Documents to be carried for the interview include: two recent passport-size colour photographs (self-attested); all educational certificates and experience certificate (if any); Caste/Category Certificate; Aadhar Card; Residential Certificate issued on or after 01/01/2023; BPL Card/Ration Card/BSKY Card/Income Certificate issued on or after 01/01/2025; and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if already employed in a Government/PSU/Autonomous body SAIL/RSP reserves the right to reject any application or cancel the candidature or the entire training process without assigning any reason All communication regarding the interview schedule will be sent via SMS to the registered mobile number, and published on the official website and the IGH notice board only

faq.question: Q1. What is SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Ref. No. HR-T&M/2498, dated 31 August 2026) issued by Steel Authority of India Limited, Rourkela Steel Plant, inviting online applications for interview-based selection of trainees for one-year, stipend-based Training Programmes for Employability and Skill Enhancement at Ispat General Hospital (IGH), Rourkela.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 112 seats are available: 100 for Medical Attendant Training, 7 for Hospital Administration Training, and 5 for OT/Anesthesia Assistant Training.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 20 September 2026. Applications open on 5 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the programme: Minimum Matric or equivalent for Medical Attendant Training; MBA/BBA/PG Diploma in Hospital Management/Hospital Administration/HR/Marketing/Finance for Hospital Administration Training; and Intermediate pass plus 1 year of Hospital Attendant/Anesthesia Attendant Training for OT/Anesthesia Assistant Training.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and not more than 35 years of age, as on the date of issue of the advertisement (31 August 2026).

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only, through https://igh.sailrsp.co.in, by selecting the "Apply for Trainee" link under "What's New" and completing the Online Application Form. No offline or other mode of application is accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview, followed by document verification and a medical fitness check. No written examination is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend for SAIL RSP IGH Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected trainees receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 7,000 (Medical Attendant Training), Rs. 15,000 (Hospital Administration Training), or Rs. 9,000 (OT/Anesthesia Assistant Training), depending on the programme.
